models_evaluated: AI-based MRI quantification tool for MS (clinically integrated)

links.outcome: Case-level sensitivity for new/enlarging lesions, AI tool vs standard radiology reports, against consensus ground truth
links.effect: AI tool sensitivity 93.3% vs 58.3% for radiology reports, with minimal loss of specificity; AI equivalent to a core trial imaging lab for lesion activity and brain volume (PBVC -0.32% vs -0.36%).
links.quote: In 397 multi-center MRI scan pairs acquired in routine practice, we demonstrate superior case-level sensitivity of a clinically integrated AI-based tool over standard radiology reports (93.3% vs 58.3%), relative to a consensus ground truth, with minimal loss of specificity.

screen.reason: Retrospective clinical validation of an AI-based MRI monitoring tool comparing its diagnostic performance against standard qualitative radiology reports and ground truth.
